notes: The tool schema here has no pieces/rests_on/other_joins fields, so I recorded the pieces as parts and each piece's rests_on as a `joined` edge to the piece under it. other_joins is empty.
Page 1 is low-resolution and several steps are ambiguous. The identities and positions of the pieces in steps 2-6 are my best reading.
Steps 2 and 4: I read the black pieces as two 6157 wheel-holder plates, four 61409 grate slopes (two per step) and two 2420 corner plates. The exact attachment points are uncertain.
The 3022 plate in step 5 and the dark-grey 3795 in step 6 are my reading of the pictures. The grey 2x6 may cover the 3022.

Step 7 sub-assembly: a 1x4 plate with two trans-yellow 1x1 groove tiles at its ends, topped by the curved brick. It is then fitted at the front of the model. Its exact contacts with the yellow and grey plates are assumed.
Step 8 shows the model flipped, with two trans-red round plates at the rear. I attached them to the rear corner plates.
Page 2 completes the 45-piece inventory: b19-b45 are the 27 pieces not used on page 1. Counts match the parts list.
As on page 1, there is no rests_on/other_joins field, so each rests_on link is recorded as a `joined` edge. other_joins is empty.
Step 9: the two 1x4.5 wheel arches (b19, b20) are the fenders over the wheel holders. I attached them to the 6157 holders (b2, b3), but the exact contact is a guess.

Steps 10-13: the placement of the flames, the 1x2 plates, the studded arch (60212), the mudguard (41854), the inverted slopes (4287b), the clip tiles (12825), the windshield slopes and tiles, and the 1x6 tiles is my best reading of low-resolution pictures. Several attachments are assumptions.
Step 14: each wheel is pressed onto a peg of a 6157 wheel holder, and each tyre is fitted onto its wheel.

The two separate groups were the front sub-assembly from step 7 and the main body. That sub-assembly is the 1x4 plate (b13), two yellow tiles (b14, b15) and the curved brick (b16). Step 7 fits it onto the front of the model, but I had left it unattached.
I added joins from b13 and b16 to the yellow 2x6 plate (b6) and the dark-grey 2x6 plate (b12), so the whole build is now one connected model. The booklet builds a single Batmobile.
Which studs the front sub-assembly clutches in step 7 is still my best reading of the picture.
